description: Permanently deletes one of your universes. A universe any of your webhooks still uses answers 409 universe_referenced; force=true deletes it, and those webhooks are disabled at their next evaluation.

force.description: A universe that any of your webhooks references (active or disabled) refuses to delete with `409 universe_referenced`, listing them in `referencing_webhooks`. Pass `force=true` to delete anyway; those webhooks are disabled at their next evaluation.

name: tickerbot_delete_universe
